headline: Structure-aware and sequence-based tools predict protein interactions and function
label: Protein Interaction Prediction Tools
summary: Recent releases extend computational prediction of protein interactions and antifungal proteins to network-scale and metagenomic inputs.
synthesis: The common thread across these releases is machine learning applied to prediction tasks, with the closest overlap between GenPPi 1.5 and AntiFP2. GenPPi 1.5 adds a Random Forest over 60 biophysical features and a Reduced Interaction Sampling algorithm to alignment-free PPI network prediction, with its title emphasizing preservation of network topology. AntiFP2 uses an ensemble of ESM2, BLAST and MERCI to predict antifungal proteins from genomic and metagenomic data. The remaining two items are less closely related: Chemprop v2 is a modular package for molecular property prediction reporting parity with v1 accuracy at higher speed, and Casanovo improvements address de novo peptide sequencing with score interpretability and database-search support. What is new in the protein-facing items is sampling designed around network topology, and ensemble models that combine ESM2 with alignment and motif-based methods.
